lines.x: Türkiye's 10-year government bond yield climbed to an all-time high of 36.97% intraday amid persistent inflation concerns and foreign investor selling.
Borsa Istanbul's BIST 100 index fell 2.36% to close at 11,131.32 points on Friday, while the Turkish lira touched 50.58 against the U.S.

UN climate talks at COP31 in Antalya ended without a final consensus after the European Union and other nations rejected a draft agreement that omitted commitments to transition away from fossil fuels.
Türkiye's Housing Price Index growth slowed to 21.1% year-on-year, marking a 6.5-year low, with real prices falling in 31 of the past 32 months due to high mortgage rates.
